assumptions: The test packet supplies a typed goal effect, success predicate, action partition, unknown IDs, source classes, evidence hashes and a distinct verifier identity.
External K1 facts are authenticated and scoped but never authoritative for policy or final answers.
GitHub Actions OIDC is a build-time distinct verifier, never a Brain runtime cognition dependency.
Any semantic byte change requires re-verification.
conclusion: Goal-directed sufficient knowing is the minimal defensible interpretation: compute the action quotient, derive the smallest decision-relevant question, use exact EVPI when a scoped hypothesis model exists, refuse open-world completeness without bounded enumeration, bind K1 facts to scope/evidence/falsifier, recompute relation terms from the current machine, and persist typed relations rather than trajectories. Learn everything, scan everything, web-as-runtime-reasoner, exact trace replay, and one-experience universal generalization are rejected or fail closed. This is a zero-credit guard/contract instrument, not a verified general capability gain.
governing_invariants: Own Brain weights and computed mechanisms only; zero runtime model calls.
Parameters hold mechanisms, never a memorized world-fact warehouse.
Knowledge and skills live in an external inspectable editable store and may change without retraining.
A distinct verifier must own independent receipts; a fresh same-identity process is not independent verification.
Hardest open unseen benchmarks are falsifiers, not the product; no score alone grants capability credit.
Delete before add; ask only for information that can change a goal-relevant decision.
Open-world completeness without a bounded enumeration certificate fails closed.
One exact action trajectory cannot identify causal variables, scope, falsifier, verifier or transfer class.
material_premises: The live project already has full scan/ask/retrieve/plan/act/verify/generalize/save mechanisms, JIT K1 knowledge, a global retrieval completeness firewall, relation grammars, one-shot falsifications and runner-owned exact-byte receipts.
Project measurements show breadth saturates, learning does not accumulate from raw traces, and the bottleneck is the index, verifier, grammar, goal and site rather than memory capacity.
2026 external-memory literature shows raw trajectories can cause negative transfer on hard cases while abstract procedural relations transfer more safely.

2026 VoI/EVPI literature supports cost-penalized clarification selected by expected downstream decision improvement, and SAGE-Agent/REVOIR use model-based variants that cannot be runtime dependencies for Brain.
2026 completeness/closure benchmarks show stopping criteria and source-scope closure remain hard failure modes.

Hardest open suites remain OSWorld 2.1 long-horizon workflows, SWE-Bench Pro V2 HARD-51, Terminal-Bench 4.1 and completeness probes; gated assets, VM images, evaluator dependencies and independent §6 verification are external blockers.
next_action: Continue the §5 loop on arbitrary purpose binding, authored repair content, GUI/browser control and fresh unseen hard-benchmark qualification; do not claim §6 or terminal truth.
non_goals: Claiming §6, terminal truth, capability, family, benchmark or score credit.
Executing OSWorld, SWE-Bench Pro V2, Terminal-Bench or any hidden-test body in this contract iteration.
Deploying websites, pulling provider images, reading hidden solutions or borrowing model outputs.
Opening a PR or merging before the whole feature is complete.

AGENTS.md rule 4; independent verification needs a distinct runner identity.

supersession_conditions: A distinct verifier falsifies exact-byte replay, exact EVPI, zero-model imports, or store editability.
A fresh unseen hard-benchmark attempt shows no transfer or a hidden model dependency.
The owner directly changes the standing mission or constraints.
A strictly smaller mechanism computes the same decisions with fewer bytes and equivalent fail-closed guarantees.
uncertainties: Whether scoped hypothesis probabilities and utilities can be computed from arbitrary natural-language goals without a model.
Whether typed relation grammars can cover authored repair content and unseen GUI/browser state.
Whether the new quotient transfers to untouched OSWorld 2.1, SWE-Bench Pro V2 HARD-51, Terminal-Bench 4.1, WebArena-Verified, DeepSearchQA, WideSearch or ClosureBench.
Whether full completeness/source-scope closure can be certified in an open world.
Whether gated assets, provider VM images, self-hosted websites, evaluator dependencies and maintainer-style §6 verification will become available.
